propositions: Jira-specific REST probe mechanics (URL shape, basic-auth GET, status classification) are embedded in backend-neutral core module inbound_probe.py, violating the zero-adapters.jira-imports constraint in core
There is no capability seam for a second backend to provide an alternate probe implementation; adding a new vendor requires duplicating or forking probe logic
run_differs.py calls probe at line 369 without routing through a backend capability, making it impossible to delegate vendor-specific behavior
Neutral vocabulary (ProbeBranch, ProbeResult, ProbeConfigError) must remain at package root for location-pinned loading, but vendor mechanics must relocate to adapters/jira/probe.py
Backend without probe capability should degrade to UNREACHABLE result rather than fail or block routing
